data.title: [Resplendent Spectrum] RE-Factor Headhunting #1 and [Tag Artist Issue] RE-Factor Issue #1 Open
data.brief: Dear Endministrator,During [Resplendent Spectrum] RE-Factor Headhunting #1, the 6★ operator [Yvonne]
data.data:
Dear Endministrator,

During [Resplendent Spectrum] RE-Factor Headhunting #1, the 6★ operator [Yvonne] is Rate-UP!

During [Tag Artist Issue] RE-Factor Issue #1, the 6★ weapon [Artzy Tyrannical (Handcannon)] is Rate-UP!


▼// Availability

Sept. 24, 2026 at 12:00 (server time) – Before version update and maintenance

※ Asia Server Time Zone: UTC+8

※ Americas / Europe Server Time Zone: UTC-5


▼// Participation Criteria

Complete the main mission [Chapter I Process I: Break the Siege]


▼// [Resplendent Spectrum] RE-Factor Headhunting #1 Details

■ Headhunting Details:

[Resplendent Spectrum] RE-Factor Headhunting features the Rate-UP 6★ operator [Yvonne]. In this headhunting, you are guaranteed to get the Rate-UP 6★ operator [Yvonne] within the first 120 headhunting attempts. This guarantee can only trigger 1 time across all [Resplendent Spectrum] RE-Factor Headhunting banners. Attempts toward this guarantee will carry over to future [Resplendent Spectrum] RE-Factor Headhunting banners.


■ Headhunting Rewards

In [Resplendent Spectrum] RE-Factor Headhunting, perform a certain number of headhunting attempts to earn corresponding rewards. The accumulated headhunting attempts will carry over to future [Resplendent Spectrum] RE-Factor Headhunting banners.


· Urgent Recruitment

After performing 30/60/90 headhunting attempts, you will respectively receive 10 bonus Urgent Recruitment attempts (i.e., 1 free 10× headhunting attempt at each milestone). This bonus can only trigger 1 time across all [Resplendent Spectrum] RE-Factor Headhunting banners. Any unused Urgent Recruitment attempts will carry over to future [Resplendent Spectrum] RE-Factor Headhunting banners.


· Token Tribute

Across all [Resplendent Spectrum] RE-Factor Headhunting banners, for every 240 headhunting attempts performed, you will receive a bonus [Yvonne's Token]×1. Attempts will carry over to future [Resplendent Spectrum] RE-Factor Headhunting banners.


▼// [Tag Artist Issue] RE-Factor Issue #1 Details

■ Issue Details

· [Tag Artist Issue] RE-Factor Issue features the Rate-UP 6★ weapon [Artzy Tyrannical (Handcannon)].

· In this Issue, if no 6★ weapons are acquired in 3 consecutive issues, then a 6★ weapon is guaranteed on the 4th issue. This guarantee is only valid for [Tag Artist Issue] RE-Factor Issue #1 and does not carry over to other Issue banners (including future [Tag Artist Issue] RE-Factor Issue banners).

· In this Issue, if the Rate-UP 6★ weapon is not acquired in the first 7 issues, then the Rate-UP 6★ weapon is guaranteed on the 8th issue. This rule can only trigger 1 time across all [Tag Artist Issue] RE-Factor Issue banners. This guarantee will carry over to future [Tag Artist Issue] RE-Factor Issue banners.


■ Issue Rewards

Perform a set number of RE-Factor Issue attempts to get [Arms OC: Tag Artist] or [Artzy Tyrannical (Handcannon)] in alternating order. The accumulated RE-Factor Issue attempts will carry over to future [Tag Artist Issue] RE-Factor Issue banners.


※ Please check in-game for more details.
